adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` now sets `selectedCalendar` to `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (undefined/null), the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`), which will almost never match a real calendar externalId, yielding `undefined`. The old code correctly fell back to `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`. The same faulty pattern appears in `deleteEvent`’s `calendarId` calculation. This can lead to an undefined calendarId being used (or an unintended fallback like `primary` if applied later), breaking updates/deletes for events without an explicit `externalCalendarId`.
